zh.name: explain
zh.source:
---
name: explain
aliases: [ex]
description: 代码解释
category: 理解与规划
params:
  level:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: 讲解深度
    default: detailed
    choices:
      - { value: brief, label: 一句话概括 }
      - { value: detailed, label: 详细讲解 }
      - { value: beginner, label: 面向新手 }
  diagram:
    type: bool
    short: d
    description: 附带 Mermaid 流程图
---
请解释{% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}这段代码{% endif %}。

{% if level == "brief" %}
用几句话说明它做什么、为什么这样做。
{% elif level == "beginner" %}
假设我不熟悉这个代码库和相关技术：先讲它解决什么问题，再按执行顺序讲关键步骤，遇到术语时简单解释。
{% else %}
包括：它解决什么问题；主要流程和数据流；关键设计决策及其原因；容易出错或不直观的地方。
{% endif %}
{% if diagram %}
附一张 Mermaid 流程图说明主要流程。
{% endif %}
只解释，不要修改代码。

zh.name: investigate
zh.description: 问题调查：收集证据、评估假设
zh.source:
---
name: investigate
aliases: [inv]
description: 问题调查：收集证据、评估假设
category: 理解与规划
params:
  depth:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: 调查深度
    default: thorough
    choices:
      - { value: quick, label: 快速 }
      - { value: thorough, label: 深入 }
  hypotheses:
    type: number
    min: 1
    max: 6
    default: 3
    description: 列出的假设数量
---
请调查{% if extra %}：{{ extra }}{% else %}这个问题{% endif %}

1. 列出已知事实和来源（代码、日志、文档），不要把推测当事实。
2. 提出 {{ hypotheses }} 个假设，按可能性排序。
3. 为每个假设收集支持和反对的证据{% if depth == "quick" %}，只做最关键的检查{% else %}，必要时阅读相关代码、运行命令或查看历史提交{% endif %}。
4. 给出结论、置信度，以及还需要哪些信息才能确认。

只调查，不要修改任何文件。

zh.name: plan
zh.description: 开发计划：拆分需求、规划实施

params.name: estimate
params.description: 给出每一步的工作量估计

zh.source:
---
name: plan
description: 开发计划：拆分需求、规划实施
category: 理解与规划
params:
  risks:
    type: bool
    default: true
    description: 列出风险与未知项
  estimate:
    type: bool
    short: e
    description: 给出每一步的工作量估计
  steps:
    type: number
    min: 3
    max: 15
    description: 最多拆成几步
---
请为{% if extra %}「{{ extra }}」{% else %}这个需求{% endif %}制定实施计划，先不要写代码。

1. 先复述需求，列出你的理解和需要我确认的问题。
2. 调研现有代码，说明需要改动的模块和文件。
3. 拆分成{% if steps %}不超过 {{ steps }} 个{% endif %}可以独立验证的步骤，每一步说明改动内容和验证方式。
{% if estimate %}
4. 给出每一步的工作量估计。
{% endif %}
{% if risks %}
列出风险、未知项和可能的替代方案。
{% endif %}
等我确认计划后再开始实施。

zh.name: arch
zh.source:
---
name: arch
description: 架构评估与技术选型
category: 理解与规划
params:
  focus:
    type: multi
    positional: true
    description: 评估维度
    choices:
      - { value: scalability, label: 可扩展性 }
      - { value: maintainability, label: 可维护性 }
      - { value: cost, label: 成本 }
      - { value: security, label: 安全 }
      - { value: complexity, label: 复杂度 }
  options:
    type: number
    min: 2
    max: 5
    default: 3
    description: 比较的方案数量
---
请评估{% if extra %}「{{ extra }}」{% else %}当前的架构设计{% endif %}。

1. 先说明现状和约束条件，区分已知事实和假设。
2. 给出 {{ options }} 个可行方案，用表格比较{% if focus %}{% for f in focus %}{{ {"scalability": "可扩展性", "maintainability": "可维护性", "cost": "成本", "security": "安全", "complexity": "复杂度"}[f] }}{% if not loop.last %}、{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% else %}可维护性、复杂度、成本和风险{% endif %}。
3. 给出推荐方案和理由，以及在什么条件下应该改选其他方案。
4. 列出实施推荐方案的主要步骤和风险。

只做分析，不要修改代码。

zh.source:
---
name: debug
description: 深度调试：定位并验证问题
category: 编写与修复
params:
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: 执行模式
    default: read
    choices:
      - { value: read, label: 只定位 }
      - { value: suggest, label: 定位并给方案 }
      - { value: apply, label: 定位并修复 }
  log:
    type: bool
    short: l
    description: 允许添加临时日志辅助定位
---
帮我调试这个问题。
{% if extra %}

现象：{{ extra }}
{% endif %}

按以下步骤进行：
1. 复述现象，列出已知事实，区分事实和推测。
2. 提出最多 3 个可能的原因，按可能性排序，并说明每个原因的验证方法。
3. 逐个验证，每一步都基于证据推进，不要猜测着修改代码。
{% if log %}
4. 可以添加临时日志或调试输出来收集证据，结束后全部移除。
{% endif %}

最后给出根因结论和证据。
{% include "_mode" %}

zh.name: refactor
zh.description: 代码重构：改善结构，行为不变
zh.source:
---
name: refactor
description: 代码重构：改善结构，行为不变
category: 编写与修复
params:
  goal:
    type: multi
    positional: true
    description: 重构目标
    choices:
      - { value: readability, label: 可读性 }
      - { value: structure, label: 模块结构 }
      - { value: naming, label: 命名 }
      - { value: duplication, label: 消除重复, aliases: [dup] }
      - { value: types, label: 类型 }
  keep-api:
    type: bool
    default: true
    description: 保持公共接口不变
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: 执行模式
    default: suggest
    choices:
      - { value: suggest, label: 先给方案 }
      - { value: apply, label: 直接重构 }
---
请重构{% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}这部分代码{% endif %}{% if goal %}，目标是改善{% for g in goal %}{{ {"readability": "可读性", "structure": "模块结构", "naming": "命名", "duplication": "重复代码", "types": "类型设计"}[g] }}{% if not loop.last %}、{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}。

约束：
1. 外部可观察的行为必须完全不变；重构前确认有测试覆盖，没有的先补上。
{% if keep_api %}
2. 保持公共接口（函数签名、导出、配置格式）不变。
{% else %}
2. 允许调整公共接口，但要列出所有受影响的调用方并一起修改。
{% endif %}
3. 分小步进行，每一步都可以单独验证。
4. 不要顺带修改与目标无关的代码。

{% include "_mode" %}

zh.name: simplify
zh.source:
---
name: simplify
aliases: [simp]
description: 代码简化
category: 编写与修复
params:
  scope:
    type: enum
    description: 范围
    default: changes
    choices:
      - { value: changes, label: 所有未提交改动 }
      - { value: staged, label: 暂存区 }
      - { value: branch, label: 当前分支 }
      - { value: last, label: 最近一次提交 }
  aggressive:
    type: bool
    short: a
    description: 允许较大幅度的简化
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: 执行模式
    default: suggest
    choices:
      - { value: suggest, label: 先给方案 }
      - { value: apply, label: 直接简化 }
---
请简化{% include "_scope" %}中的代码。

寻找：重复的逻辑、可以用现有工具函数替代的代码、不必要的抽象和间接层、过度防御的检查、冗余的注释。
{% if aggressive %}
可以合并或删除整个模块，但要说明理由并保证行为不变。
{% else %}
只做局部简化，不改变整体结构。
{% endif %}
行为必须保持不变。

{% include "_mode" %}
{% include "_extra" %}

zh.source:
---
name: test
description: 测试生成
category: 审查与测试
params:
  kind:
    type: multi
    positional: true
    description: 测试类型
    choices:
      - { value: unit, label: 单元测试 }
      - { value: integration, label: 集成测试 }
      - { value: edge, label: 边界条件 }
      - { value: regression, label: 回归测试 }
  framework:
    type: string
    description: 使用的测试框架（默认沿用项目现有框架）
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: 执行模式
    default: apply
    choices:
      - { value: suggest, label: 只给出测试代码 }
      - { value: apply, label: 直接写入并运行 }
---
请为{% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}当前改动涉及的代码{% endif %}编写{% if kind %}{% for k in kind %}{{ {"unit": "单元测试", "integration": "集成测试", "edge": "边界条件测试", "regression": "回归测试"}[k] }}{% if not loop.last %}、{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% else %}测试{% endif %}。

要求：
1. {% if framework %}使用 {{ framework }}。{% else %}沿用项目现有的测试框架、目录结构和命名习惯。{% endif %}

2. 测试行为而不是实现细节；每个测试只验证一件事，名称能说明预期。
3. 覆盖正常路径、边界值、错误输入和异常分支。
4. 不要为了让测试通过而修改被测代码；发现疑似 bug 时单独指出。
{% if mode == "apply" %}
5. 写完后运行测试并报告结果。
{% endif %}

zh.name: commit
zh.source:
---
name: commit
aliases: [ci]
description: 生成提交信息
category: 提交与文档
params:
  style:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: 格式
    default: conventional
    choices:
      - { value: conventional, label: Conventional Commits }
      - { value: plain, label: 普通格式 }
  lang:
    type: enum
    description: 语言
    default: en
    choices:
      - { value: en, label: 英文 }
      - { value: zh, label: 中文 }
  run:
    type: bool
    description: 生成后直接执行提交
---
请根据暂存区的改动（git diff --cached）写一条提交信息，使用{{ "中文" if lang == "zh" else "英文" }}。

{% if style == "conventional" %}
格式遵循 Conventional Commits：`type(scope): subject`，type 从 feat、fix、refactor、docs、test、chore、perf 中选择。
{% endif %}
- 标题不超过 72 个字符，说明做了什么。
- 正文说明为什么这样改，以及需要注意的影响；简单的改动可以省略正文。
- 参考 git log 中已有提交的风格。

{% if run %}
确认无误后直接执行 git commit。
{% else %}
只输出提交信息，不要执行提交。
{% endif %}
{% include "_extra" %}

en.name: explain
en.source:
---
name: explain
aliases: [ex]
description: Explain code
category: Understand & plan
params:
  level:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: Level of detail
    default: detailed
    choices:
      - { value: brief, label: One-line summary }
      - { value: detailed, label: Detailed }
      - { value: beginner, label: For beginners }
  diagram:
    type: bool
    short: d
    description: Include a Mermaid diagram
---
Explain {% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}this code{% endif %}.

{% if level == "brief" %}
In a few sentences, say what it does and why it is done this way.
{% elif level == "beginner" %}
Assume I'm new to this codebase and its technologies: start with the problem it solves, then walk through the key steps in execution order, explaining terms as they come up.
{% else %}
Cover: the problem it solves; the main flow and data flow; key design decisions and why they were made; anything error-prone or non-obvious.
{% endif %}
{% if diagram %}
Include a Mermaid flowchart of the main flow.
{% endif %}
Explain only; don't modify the code.

en.name: investigate
en.source:
---
name: investigate
aliases: [inv]
description: "Investigate: gather evidence, weigh hypotheses"
category: Understand & plan
params:
  depth:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: Depth
    default: thorough
    choices:
      - { value: quick, label: Quick }
      - { value: thorough, label: Thorough }
  hypotheses:
    type: number
    min: 1
    max: 6
    default: 3
    description: Number of hypotheses
---
Investigate {% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}this problem{% endif %}.

1. List the known facts and where they come from (code, logs, docs); don't treat guesses as facts.
2. Propose {{ hypotheses }} hypotheses, most likely first.
3. Gather evidence for and against each{% if depth == "quick" %}, checking only what matters most{% else %}, reading the relevant code, running commands or checking history where needed{% endif %}.
4. Give a conclusion, your confidence, and what else would be needed to confirm it.

Investigate only; don't modify any files.

en.name: plan
en.description: Implementation plan: break down the work
en.source:
---
name: plan
description: "Implementation plan: break down the work"
category: Understand & plan
params:
  risks:
    type: bool
    default: true
    description: List risks and unknowns
  estimate:
    type: bool
    short: e
    description: Estimate each step
  steps:
    type: number
    min: 3
    max: 15
    description: Maximum number of steps
---
Make an implementation plan for {% if extra %}"{{ extra }}"{% else %}this requirement{% endif %}. Don't write code yet.

1. Restate the requirement, listing your understanding and the questions I need to answer.
2. Study the existing code and name the modules and files that need to change.
3. Break the work into {% if steps %}at most {{ steps }} {% endif %}steps that can each be verified, with what changes and how to verify it.
{% if estimate %}
4. Estimate the effort for each step.
{% endif %}
{% if risks %}
List risks, unknowns and possible alternatives.
{% endif %}
Wait for me to confirm the plan before starting.

en.name: arch
en.source:
---
name: arch
description: Architecture review and technology choices
category: Understand & plan
params:
  focus:
    type: multi
    positional: true
    description: Criteria
    choices:
      - { value: scalability, label: Scalability }
      - { value: maintainability, label: Maintainability }
      - { value: cost, label: Cost }
      - { value: security, label: Security }
      - { value: complexity, label: Complexity }
  options:
    type: number
    min: 2
    max: 5
    default: 3
    description: Number of options to compare
---
Evaluate {% if extra %}"{{ extra }}"{% else %}the current architecture{% endif %}.

1. Describe the current state and constraints, separating known facts from assumptions.
2. Give {{ options }} viable options and compare them in a table on {% if focus %}{% for f in focus %}{{ {"scalability": "scalability", "maintainability": "maintainability", "cost": "cost", "security": "security", "complexity": "complexity"}[f] }}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}{% else %}maintainability, complexity, cost and risk{% endif %}.
3. Recommend one with reasons, and say under what conditions another option would be better.
4. List the main steps and risks of implementing the recommendation.

Analyze only; don't modify the code.

en.name: fix
en.description: Fix a bug: find the root cause, change as little as possible

en.name: debug
en.description: Deep debugging: locate and verify the cause
en.source:
---
name: debug
description: "Deep debugging: locate and verify the cause"
category: Write & fix
params:
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: Execution mode
    default: read
    choices:
      - { value: read, label: Locate only }
      - { value: suggest, label: Locate and propose a fix }
      - { value: apply, label: Locate and fix }
  log:
    type: bool
    short: l
    description: Allow temporary logging
---
Help me debug this problem.
{% if extra %}

Symptom: {{ extra }}
{% endif %}

Work through it step by step:
1. Restate the symptom and list what is known; keep facts and guesses separate.
2. Propose up to three possible causes, most likely first, with a way to verify each.
3. Verify them one at a time. Let evidence drive each step; don't change code on a hunch.
{% if log %}
4. You may add temporary logging or debug output to gather evidence; remove all of it when done.
{% endif %}

Finish with the root cause and the evidence for it.
{% include "_mode" %}

en.name: refactor
en.description: Refactor: improve structure without changing behavior
en.source:
---
name: refactor
description: "Refactor: improve structure without changing behavior"
category: Write & fix
params:
  goal:
    type: multi
    positional: true
    description: What to improve
    choices:
      - { value: readability, label: Readability }
      - { value: structure, label: Module structure }
      - { value: naming, label: Naming }
      - { value: duplication, label: Remove duplication, aliases: [dup] }
      - { value: types, label: Types }
  keep-api:
    type: bool
    default: true
    description: Keep the public API unchanged
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: Execution mode
    default: suggest
    choices:
      - { value: suggest, label: Plan first }
      - { value: apply, label: Refactor directly }
---
Refactor {% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}this code{% endif %}{% if goal %} to improve {% for g in goal %}{{ {"readability": "readability", "structure": "module structure", "naming": "naming", "duplication": "duplicated code", "types": "type design"}[g] }}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}.

Constraints:
1. Observable behavior must not change. Make sure tests cover it before refactoring; add them if they don't.
{% if keep_api %}
2. Keep the public API (function signatures, exports, configuration format) unchanged.
{% else %}
2. You may change the public API, but list every affected caller and update them together.
{% endif %}
3. Work in small steps that can each be verified.
4. Don't touch code unrelated to the goal.

{% include "_mode" %}

en.name: simplify
en.source:
---
name: simplify
aliases: [simp]
description: Simplify code
category: Write & fix
params:
  scope:
    type: enum
    description: Scope
    default: changes
    choices:
      - { value: changes, label: All uncommitted changes }
      - { value: staged, label: Staged changes }
      - { value: branch, label: Current branch }
      - { value: last, label: Last commit }
  aggressive:
    type: bool
    short: a
    description: Allow larger simplifications
  mode:
    type: enum
    description: Execution mode
    default: suggest
    choices:
      - { value: suggest, label: Plan first }
      - { value: apply, label: Simplify directly }
---
Simplify the code in {% include "_scope" %}.

Look for duplicated logic, code that existing helpers could replace, unnecessary abstractions and indirection, overly defensive checks, and redundant comments.
{% if aggressive %}
You may merge or remove whole modules, but explain why and keep behavior unchanged.
{% else %}
Make local simplifications only; don't change the overall structure.
{% endif %}
Behavior must stay the same.

{% include "_mode" %}
{% include "_extra" %}

      - { value: apply, label: Write and run them }
---
Write {% if kind %}{% for k in kind %}{{ {"unit": "unit tests", "integration": "integration tests", "edge": "edge-case tests", "regression": "regression tests"}[k] }}{% if not loop.last %} and {% endif %}{% endfor %}{% else %}tests{% endif %} for {% if extra %}{{ extra }}{% else %}the code touched by the current changes{% endif %}.

Requirements:
1. {% if framework %}Use {{ framework }}.{% else %}Follow the project's existing test framework, layout and naming.{% endif %}

2. Test behavior, not implementation details; one thing per test, with a name that states the expectation.
3. Cover the normal path, boundary values, invalid input and error branches.
4. Don't change the code under test to make tests pass; point out suspected bugs separately.
{% if mode == "apply" %}
5. Run the tests when you're done and report the results.
{% endif %}

en.name: commit
en.source:
---
name: commit
aliases: [ci]
description: Write a commit message
category: Ship
params:
  style:
    type: enum
    positional: true
    description: Format
    default: conventional
    choices:
      - { value: conventional, label: Conventional Commits }
      - { value: plain, label: Plain }
  lang:
    type: enum
    description: Language
    default: en
    choices:
      - { value: en, label: English }
      - { value: zh, label: Chinese }
  run:
    type: bool
    description: Commit when done
---
Write a commit message in {{ "Chinese" if lang == "zh" else "English" }} for the staged changes (git diff --cached).

{% if style == "conventional" %}
Follow Conventional Commits: `type(scope): subject`, with type one of feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf.
{% endif %}
- Keep the subject under 72 characters and say what changed.
- Use the body to explain why, and anything to watch out for; simple changes can skip the body.
- Match the style of existing commits in git log.

{% if run %}
Run git commit once it looks right.
{% else %}
Output the message only; don't commit.
{% endif %}
{% include "_extra" %}
